notes: Tier: HTTP fetch (curl SSR HTML) for SFCC-rendered dinnerware-collection pages, escalated to Playwright (Chromium, headless) for the /holidays/ hub pages whose product grid loads client-side (data-testid=hardgood-category-header-skeleton). robots.txt has no Claude-specific disallow, so no policy block. Discovery: checked sitemap_index.xml -> sitemap_0.xml filtered for christmas/halloween/thanksgiving/valentine/easter/diwali/hanukkah/lunar/new-year/4th-of-july keywords; checked the site's own /holidays/ hub and its rendered nav links; checked /products/.../dinnerware/dinnerware-collections/ sibling list (all named dinnerware patterns) for holiday-named entries; checked header nav and footer links. Genuine holiday taxonomy found: Holidays > Christmas, Holidays > Halloween, Holidays > Thanksgiving (with 5 tabbed sub-facets: Kitchen Tools, Small Appliances, Knives & Boards, Food, Entertaining), Holidays > Valentine's Day, Holidays > Lunar New Year (both currently 0 items - confirmed via rendered PLP text 'No results match you...' not a load failure, i.e. genuinely out-of-season/destocked, not absent from taxonomy), plus two Christmas/Independence-Day dinnerware collections reached only via the Dining & Bar > Dinnerware > Dinnerware Collections branch (Nutcracker, 4th of July). EXCLUDED as not genuine holiday categories: /christmas-shop/ (editorial 'Christmas Headquarters' hub page, no product grid/count, links only to generic pages) - marketing/landing page rule; /easter-collection/ and /entertaining/easter/ both return HTTP 410 (removed, no live Easter category); /holidays/thanksgiving/roasting-pans/ redirects to the ordinary Products>Cookware>Oven>Roasting Pans category (not holiday-branded, breadcrumb has no Holidays/Thanksgiving) - normal category rule; the 'Bakers & Casseroles' Thanksgiving tab link resolves to the ordinary Products>Bakeware>Bakeware>Bakers & Casseroles category (same exclusion reason); /products/dining-bar/dinnerware/dinnerware-collections/thanksgiving/thanksgiving-harvest/ shows 0 Items (broken/empty sub-page) - excluded; no Diwali, Hanukkah, or generic 'New Year' (non-lunar) category found anywhere in the sitemap or nav. DEDUPE: /products/dining-bar/featured/thanksgiving/ and /holidays/thanksgiving/entertaining/ both 301-redirect to the identical dinnerware-collections/thanksgiving PLP (69 items) - counted once. /products/dining-bar/featured/halloween/ 301-redirects to /holidays/halloween-1/ - counted once. GROUPING: /holidays/thanksgiving-1/ (252 Items) is a tabbed hub whose 5 sibling facet tabs (Kitchen Tools 70, Small Appliances 54, Knives & Boards 58, Food 20, Entertaining/Dinnerware 69) sum to 271, closely tracking and exceeding the parent's displayed 252 (facet overlap) - treated per instructions as a grouping row (qty null) with the 5 tabs as the real leaf rows, to avoid double counting. By contrast /holidays/christmas-1/ (184 Items) has only one minor internal subset tab, 'Holiday Entertaining' (35 items, breadcrumb Home>Holidays>Christmas>Holiday Entertaining), covering under 20% of the total; since the remaining ~149 items have no further site-imposed subdivision, Christmas is kept as a single leaf row at its true displayed total (184) and 'Holiday Entertaining' is noted here rather than double-counted as a separate additive row. The Nutcracker Collection page (title 'Nutcracker Dinnerware Collection', 26 items) is not itself literally titled 'Christmas' but its own product copy explicitly says 'Bring the magic of Christmas into your home' and lists items named 'Christmas Tree Cheese Board' / 'Christmas Tree Dinner Plate' confirming genuine Christmas association; it lives on a separate taxonomy branch (Dining & Bar, not Holidays) than the 184-item Christmas hub and is not reachable from it, so it is additive, not a subset. Independence Day (4th of July, 32 items) included as 'any other genuine seasonal/holiday event' per task scope; it is a distinct dinnerware-collections pattern page with its own breadcrumb/title, unrelated in scope to the Christmas/Thanksgiving/Halloween hub. Qty method: SSR PLP header 'NN Items' text for the dinnerware-collections/nutcracker/4th-of-july pages (curl); rendered-DOM 'NN Items' text via Playwright for all /holidays/ hub and tab pages (site loads that grid client-side, no SSR count present in raw HTML).
